quota.label: Storage
welcome.title: Welcome to Hoard
welcome.tagline_1: Cloud sync for your game saves —
welcome.tagline_3: data. Hoard runs quietly in the background and uploads new saves whenever you finish playing.
welcome.bullet_1: Detects games you have installed automatically.
welcome.bullet_2: Backs up after each session, never while a game is running.
welcome.bullet_3: Restores any past version with two clicks.
server.title: Connect to your server
server.subtitle: Paste the address of the Hoard server you (or your admin) set up.
server.address_hint: The same URL you would open in a web browser.
server.invalid_url: Address must start with http:// or https://
token.title: Sign in
token.subtitle: Paste the access key for your account on
token.access_key_hint: Your server admin can create one with `hoard-admin token create <username>`.
token.invalid_key: That doesn't look like a Hoard access key. It should start with `hoard_v1_` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.
onboarding_done.subtitle: Hoard now has everything it needs to keep your saves in sync.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.tracked_count: {count, plural, one {# tracked save} other {# tracked saves}}
dashboard.no_saves_body: Head to the Library and pick a game — Hoard will auto-back-up its saves whenever they change.
dashboard.tooltip_paused: This save is paused — open History to resume
library.title: Library
library.subtitle_scanned: Scanned {catalog} catalog entries — found {found} on this machine
library.subtitle_initial: Scan your machine to find games whose save folders Hoard knows about.
library.no_results_empty: Nothing detected yet. Try installing a few games or running a deeper scan.
library.no_save_yet_toast: No save folder yet — start the game once, then re-scan to track it.
library.no_scan_title: No scan yet on this session.
library.no_scan_body: Hoard will check ~10,000 catalog entries against your filesystem and Steam library. The first scan takes 10–30 seconds.
library.tracked_size_title: Total bytes stored on the server (sum of snapshots)
history.not_found_hint: It may have been removed from this machine.
history.no_backups_body: Your first backup runs as soon as the game writes new save data — or hit "Back up now" above.
history.restore_description: Files in {path} will be overwritten with the contents of this version.
history.backup_first_hint: Recommended. Saves what's in the folder right now as a fresh version, so you can roll back if you restored the wrong one.
history.restore_warning: Restore overwrites the current files. If the game is running, quit it first or your progress in this session may be lost.
history.delete_description: The version stays recoverable from the trash for the server's retention window (default 30 days). After that it's gone for good.
history.delete_body: Deleted versions don't count against your storage quota and can be recovered from the "Show recoverable" toggle above this list.
history.edit_folder_description: Tell Hoard where this save lives now. Use the full path to the folder, exactly as it appears in your file manager.
history.restored_toast: {count, plural, one {Restored v{version} — # file{safety}.} other {Restored v{version} — # files{safety}.}}
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Tweak how Hoard behaves on this machine. Changes are saved as soon as you toggle them.
settings.close_to_tray_desc: Closing the window keeps Hoard running in the background so backups continue. Quit from the tray icon to stop it.
settings.autostart_desc: Adds Hoard to your launcher. Pair with “Start minimised” for a quiet boot.
settings.start_minimised_desc: Launch with the window hidden — only the tray icon shows up.
settings.telemetry_desc: Help us see how many people are using Hoard. We only count events (successful backup, restore, first-run completed) — never your username, game names, save paths, file contents, or tokens. Off by default.
settings.notify_success_desc: A small desktop notification when a backup uploads successfully. Turn this off once you trust the agent.
settings.notify_failure_desc: Alerts you when a backup fails, even after retries. We strongly recommend leaving this on.
settings.autostart_rejected: The OS rejected the autostart change — try enabling autostart from your launcher settings.
settings.language_desc: Choose the language Hoard uses for menus, buttons, and messages.
settings.catalog_desc: Hoard auto-detects games using the Ludusavi catalog. We refresh it weekly in the background — hit the button to pull the latest list now.
settings.view_logs_desc: Inspect the agent's activity log. Handy for bug reports.
settings.about_line_2: Your server, your data. Source code & docs at hoard.dev.
logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Tail of the most recent agent log. Useful for bug reports — hit "Copy" to get the visible lines on your clipboard.
logs.empty_no_logs: The agent hasn't written any logs yet on this machine.
history.choose_destination_description: Hoard doesn't know a save folder for this game on this machine yet. Pick a folder and we'll create it if it doesn't exist.
history.pick_destination_dialog_title: Choose a folder for the restored save
